address: W Doha Hotel & Residences, Diplomatic Street, West Bay, Doha, Qatar
bio: Buzzy, colourful and lively, with a hint of Aztec style, this restaurant has all the ingredients for a fun night out. Take a seat in the moody and intimate split-level dining room, where you can see the chefs working in an open kitchen on a range of Peruvian-inspired dishes designed for sharing. Quality ingredients run throughout and there’s a freshness and vibrancy to the flavours. Engaging, attentive service completes the picture....
